in_marathi.name: Daroga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Daroga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'daru' meaning 'wood' and 'gahana' meaning 'difficult'. In Hindu mythology, Daroga refers to a brave soldier or a guardian of a temple or a fortress.
